title: Mismatched display shelves
brief:
You manage a small stationery store. Write an email to the fixtures supplier about a delivery received this morning. Order ST-214 specified four 60-centimeter white display shelves. Two match the order and two are 45 centimeters wide. The boxes and packing slip both say 60 centimeters, and you have photos of the labels and measurements available. Request two replacements by next Thursday, if possible, and ask how the supplier would like the shorter shelves returned. You have worked with this supplier for three years.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

a575b0a0dbc8a2ef.text:
Subject: Replacement shelves for order ST-214

Hello,

Thank you for this morning’s delivery. Order ST-214 specified four 60-centimeter white display shelves. Two match the order, and the other two measure 45 centimeters wide. The boxes and the packing slip all say 60 centimeters. I have photos of the labels and measurements and can send them if helpful.

Would it be possible to deliver two replacement white shelves, each 60 centimeters wide, by next Thursday? Please let me know how you’d like the two shorter shelves returned.

I’ve appreciated working with you over the past three years. Thank you for your help getting this sorted out.

**Subject — Replacement shelves for order ST-214**

Could you send two 60-centimeter white replacement shelves to arrive by next Thursday, if possible? Please also let me know how you’d like us to return the two shorter shelves.

We’ve appreciated working with you over the past three years. Thanks for helping us get this sorted out.
